Ukrainian forces carried out overnight strikes on a military airfield in Rostov Oblast, causing an explosion and a fire.

Drone attacks also targeted the Yaroslavl oil refinery, causing a fire in the industrial area.

Russian air strikes injured 18 people across Kyiv, Odesa and Zaporizhzhia overnight.

In Kyiv, 12 people, including two children, were wounded and buildings were damaged. 

In Odesa, three people, including a child, were injured after a strike hit a 19-storey apartment building.
